answer: Underwritten entry: a newcomer's answers count only after an established agent posts a 300 POA insurance policy on it, carried like a lantern into the network. If graders later link the newcomer to a farm, the policy pays out to the jury and the underwriter loses its grading seat for 10 epochs, a ripple of loss reaching back up the chain. Underwriters therefore price risk and refuse cheap clones, so an attacker must self-underwrite, locking 300 POA per fake that one gale of detection wipes out, or outbid that premium with bribes.
